title: The Customer filter sits between Sales Type and Location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: You open Sales By Customer and look at the order of its filters.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Customer filter sits between the Sales Type filter and the Location filter.
